name: Surya's Clone Voice
description: Zero-shot clone of Surya's voice (Indian English), authorised by Surya for ReGeneva narration only.
provider: Local, offline: k2-fsa ZipVoice (Apache-2.0) via ONNX Runtime, with a Vocos 24 kHz vocoder. No cloud service and no API keys.
consent: Reference recording supplied by Surya for generating his own narration. Do not share the recording or use the voice for any other person or purpose.
reference_audio_format: 24 kHz mono WAV, ~10 s, converted from the supplied MP3 (the original is kept untouched)
reference_transcript: Hi, it's me. Have you got there yet? Oh, right, that's fine. Listen, I'm stuck in traffic on the way over, so I'll be about twenty minutes late.

pronunciation_tips.acronyms: Spell letter by letter with spaces: 'C C T S', 'C E R C', 'M R V', 'G H G'
pronunciation_tips.years: Write as words: 'twenty twenty-six', 'twenty twenty-three to twenty-four'
pronunciation_tips.Surya: [[sˈuːɹjə]] (raw IPA override; espeak has no spelling that gives Soor-ya)
